title: Chicken in Mole Poblano
summary: Toasted ancho chillies blended with raisins, almonds, sesame, spices and chocolate into a deep sauce, then chicken cooked in it.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks, skin removed

steps.title: Toast the chillies
steps.text: Heat the oven to 160 °C. Toast the anchos on the tray for 5 min until pliable, cool, then discard the stems and seeds and tear them into pieces.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Cover the chillies and raisins with the 470 ml hot stock for 10 min, then drain over a bowl and keep the liquid.

steps.title: Make the paste
steps.text: Blend the onion, 2 tbsp oil, tomato purée, garlic, chipotle and soaked chillies for 4-5 min until smooth. Add the almonds, bread, 2 tbsp of the sesame seeds, salt, spices and 60 ml soaking liquid and blend to a thick paste.

steps.title: Fry and bake
steps.text: Heat the remaining oil in the casserole over medium-high heat and fry the paste for 3 min, stirring. Stir in the chocolate, then bake uncovered for 30 min, stirring twice, until darker.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Set the casserole over medium-high heat and whisk in the rest of the soaking liquid and the 350 ml stock until smooth.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken in one layer, cover and cook on low for 30-35 min, turning halfway, until every piece reads at least 74 °C next to the bone. Serve with the sauce and the last of the sesame seeds.

tips: Remove all the chilli seeds for a milder sauce.
The sauce tastes even better the next day.
Serve with rice and warm tortillas.
storage: Cool quickly and keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until piping hot (75 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
